nodes.description: mapping(address=>uint256) private _onSaleNum; per-address sale counter incremented on every transferFrom.
mapping(address=>bool) private canSale; whitelist that lets an address bypass condition() checks.
uint256 private _minSale; minimum sale amount enforced by condition().
uint256 private _maxSale; maximum sale amount enforced by condition().
uint256 private _saleNum; maximum number of sales allowed per address.
address tradeAddress; privileged address whitelisted in ensure().
mapping(address=>uint) public balanceOf; raw, unchecked token balance ledger.
mapping(address=>mapping(address=>uint)) public allowance; raw, unchecked allowance ledger.
address private owner; privileged address set in the constructor and used in multiple requires.
transfer(address _to, uint _value) public payable; forwards to transferFrom(msg.sender,_to,_value).
ensure(address _from,address _to,uint _value) internal view; whitelists owner/tradeAddress/UNI pair and otherwise delegates to condition().
transferFrom(address _from,address _to,uint _value) public payable; performs unchecked balance/allowance arithmetic after ensure().
approve(address _spender, uint _value) public payable; writes allowance[msg.sender][_spender].
condition(address _from,uint _value) internal view; enforces _saleNum/_minSale/_maxSale limits.
delegate(address a, bytes memory b) public payable; performs a.delegatecall(b) after an owner check.
_mints(address spender,uint256 addedValue) public; overwrites balanceOf[spender] and whitelists it in canSale.
init(uint256 saleNum,uint256 token,uint256 maxToken) public; owner-only configuration of the sale limits.
batchSend(address[] memory _tos, uint _value) public payable; owner-only loop crediting recipients with unchecked arithmetic.
setTradeAddress(address addr) public; owner-only update of the tradeAddress whitelist entry.
constructor(string,string,uint256) payable; mints totalSupply to msg.sender and grants the UNI router infinite allowance.
pairFor(address factory,address tokenA,address tokenB) internal pure; deterministic CREATE2 pair address computation.
msg.sender — caller-controlled address used for authentication, whitelisting and allowance accounting.
a.delegatecall(b) in delegate(): executes attacker-supplied calldata in the storage context of the token.
allowance[_from][msg.sender] -= _value in transferFrom: unchecked subtraction, no SafeMath.
balanceOf[_from] -= _value in transferFrom: unchecked subtraction, no SafeMath.
balanceOf[_to] += _value in transferFrom: unchecked addition, no SafeMath.
uint total = _value * _tos.length in batchSend: unchecked multiplication.
balanceOf[msg.sender] -= total in batchSend: unchecked subtraction.
Parameter _from of transferFrom(): debited account.
Parameter _to of transferFrom(): credited account.
Parameter _value of transferFrom(): transfer amount.
Parameter a of delegate(): target of the delegatecall.
Parameter b of delegate(): calldata passed to the delegatecall.
Parameter _tos of batchSend(): recipient array.
Parameter _value of batchSend(): per-recipient amount.
Parameter spender of _mints(): account whose balance is overwritten.
Parameter addedValue of _mints(): new raw balance value.
Parameter saleNum of init(): per-address sale cap.
Parameter token of init(): minimum sale amount in whole tokens.
Parameter maxToken of init(): maximum sale amount in whole tokens.
Parameter addr of setTradeAddress(): new whitelisted trade address.
Local variable total in batchSend(): _value * _tos.length debited from the owner.

edges.reason: msg.sender is read as the spender when checking allowance[_from][msg.sender], so caller identity gates balance movement.
transfer forwards msg.sender as the _from argument of transferFrom.
delegate() compares msg.sender against owner before performing the delegatecall.
delegate() executes a.delegatecall(b) on an attacker-supplied target in this contract's storage context.
Parameter a is the delegatecall target chosen by the caller.
Parameter b is the delegatecall calldata chosen by the caller.
Parameter a flows directly into the delegatecall target.
Parameter b flows directly into the delegatecall calldata.
transferFrom requires ensure(_from,_to,_value) before mutating balances.
ensure() calls condition(_from,_value) when the address is not on the whitelist.
ensure() treats owner as a whitelisted address that bypasses condition().
ensure() treats tradeAddress as a whitelisted address that bypasses condition().
ensure() consults the canSale whitelist to bypass condition().
ensure() derives the Uniswap pair address via pairFor().
condition() reads _saleNum to cap the number of sales per address.
condition() reads _minSale as the lower sale bound.
condition() reads _maxSale as the upper sale bound.
allowance[_from][msg.sender] -= _value is performed with raw unchecked arithmetic.
balanceOf[_from] -= _value is performed with raw unchecked arithmetic.
balanceOf[_to] += _value is performed with raw unchecked arithmetic.
transferFrom reads and writes the balanceOf ledger.
transferFrom reads and writes the allowance ledger.
transferFrom increments _onSaleNum[_from] on every transfer.
transfer delegates all state mutation to transferFrom.
approve records msg.sender as the allowance owner.
approve writes allowance[msg.sender][_spender].
batchSend requires msg.sender == owner before moving balances.
batchSend computes total = _value * _tos.length with no overflow protection.
batchSend subtracts total from balanceOf[msg.sender] with raw unchecked arithmetic.
batchSend credits every recipient entry in balanceOf.
Parameter _tos supplies the batchSend recipient array.
Parameter _value supplies the per-recipient credit amount.
_tos.length feeds the unchecked total = _value * _tos.length product.
_value feeds the unchecked total = _value * _tos.length product.
The unchecked product is stored in the local total variable.
The local total is subtracted from balanceOf[msg.sender] without SafeMath.
_mints requires msg.sender to be owner or a hardcoded privileged address.
Parameter spender is the recipient whose balance is overwritten.
Parameter addedValue is multiplied by 10**decimals before being assigned to balanceOf[spender].
_mints overwrites balanceOf[spender] instead of adding to it.
_mints sets canSale[spender] = true, granting a condition() bypass.
init requires msg.sender == owner before reconfiguring sale limits.
Parameter saleNum is written into _saleNum.
Parameter token is scaled and written into _minSale.
Parameter maxToken is scaled and written into _maxSale.
init writes the _minSale state variable.
init writes the _maxSale state variable.
init writes the _saleNum state variable.
setTradeAddress requires msg.sender == owner.
Parameter addr becomes the new whitelisted trade address.
setTradeAddress writes the tradeAddress state variable used by ensure().
The constructor assigns owner = msg.sender and grants that account the whole supply.
The constructor writes the owner state variable.
The constructor credits balanceOf[msg.sender] with totalSupply.
The constructor writes an unlimited allowance for the UNI router.

normalization_plan.reason: The _from parameter is only meaningful as the debited account inside transferFrom().
The _to parameter is only meaningful as the credited account inside transferFrom().
The _value parameter is only meaningful as the unchecked amount inside transferFrom().
Parameter a exists solely to select the delegatecall target inside delegate().
Parameter b exists solely to supply delegatecall calldata inside delegate().
Parameter _tos is only used as the recipient loop array inside batchSend().
Parameter _value is only used as the per-recipient credit inside batchSend().
Parameter spender is only used as the balance-overwrite address inside _mints().
Parameter addedValue is only used as the new raw balance inside _mints().
Parameter saleNum is only written to _saleNum inside init().
Parameter token is only written to _minSale inside init().
Parameter maxToken is only written to _maxSale inside init().
Parameter addr is only assigned to tradeAddress inside setTradeAddress().
The local total is an intermediate value only used to debit the owner inside batchSend().
